item.title: Texas SNAP recipients can no longer use benefits for candy and soda
item.description: Starting April 1, Texas SNAP recipients will no longer be able to use their benefits to purchase candy and sweetened drinks with more than five grams of added sugar.

item.title: Statewide emergency warning systems drill to take place on April 2
item.description: This Thursday a statewide drill for local public warning systems will happen between the times, 10 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. According to the Texas Division of Emergency Management (TDEM), the drill's purpose is to make sure Texans can be notified efficiently in times of disasters and emergencies.

item.title: Voice of Hope stands as one service survivors can look to
item.description: Voice of Hope is an organization that provides support and resources to survivors of sexual assault, including a 24-hour hotline, counseling, and advocacy, and reported 143 survivors of sex trafficking in the South Plains region in 2025, 20% of whom were minors.
